spots.name: Château d'Angers
spots.summary: The Château d'Angers is a castle in the city of Angers in the Loire Valley, in the département of Maine-et-Loire, in France. Founded in the 9th century by the Counts of Anjou, it was expanded to its current size in the 13th century. It is located overhanging the River Maine.

spots.name: jardin du mail
spots.summary: The Jardin du Mail is a historic 19th-century French formal garden located in the city center of Angers, France, situated directly opposite the town hall. Designed in its current layout by landscape architect André Leroy, the public park features symmetrical flowerbeds, a central fountain, an ornate 19th-century bandstan, tree-lined promenades, and several classical sculptures.
